mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, we are looking at 63 degrees under overcast skies at Fireman's Park with a third quarter moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona welcomes Liz Gay as our new EMS Deputy Chief. She brings extensive paramedic and leadership experience to the role starting November 2. Also, remember that Pellitteri Waste Systems handles our refuse and recycling, so be sure to have your carts out by 7 AM.

There is plenty to do today! You can test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Paddy Mac's and yoga at Insight Wellness.
Regarding local safety, on October 25, officers arrested a man for O W I after finding his vehicle stopped at an intersection for an extended period.
Enjoy a treat with today's flavor, Turtle Cheesecake. Culver's of Verona opens today at 10:00 AM.
